title.en: AN ACT CREATING THE METROPOLITAN BAGUIO CITY, LA TRINIDAD, ITOGON, SABLAN, TUBA, AND TUBLAY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY (MBLISTTDA), DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR

text.en:
Declaration of Policy. - It is hereby declared
the policy of the State to pursue the acceleration of social, economic,
and political development of local government units (LGUs) and
their communities through the creation of special development
and administrative areas that will ensure the efficient and effective
planning, supervision, and coordination of essential basic services,
without prejudice to the autonomy of the LGUs concerned.

2

Creation and Mandate of the Metropolitan Baguio
City, La Trinidad, Itogon, Sablan, Tuba, and Tublay Development
Authority (MBLISTTDA). - There is hereby created a
government instrumentality to be named as the Metropolitan
Baguio City, La Trinidad, Itogon, Sablan, Tuba, and Tublay
Development Authority, hereinafter referred to as MBLISTTDA,
which shall administer a special development and administrative
area embracing the City of Baguio and the municipalities of
La Trinidad, Itogon, Sablan, Tuba, and Tublay. The MBLISTTDA
shall be under the administrative supervision of the Office of the
President of the Philippines.
The MBLISTTDA shall serve as the platform for the
acceleration of the social, economic, and political developments in
the area as a unified management unit by enabling the component
LGUs to respond to common developmental challenges through
unified, effective, and economically efficient programs and
undertakings. The MBLISTTDA shall perform planning,
monitoring, and coordinative functions. It shall exercise regulatory
and supervisory authority over the delivery of area-wide services
within the jurisdictions of the concerned city and municipalities
without diminution of the autonomy of the LGUs concerning
purely local matters.

Scope of MBLISTTDA Services.
MBLISTTDA shall provide services that shall take into
consideration the needs of the population within the territory of
the LGUs concerned. These services shall include the following:
(a) Development Planning and Preparation of Medium-
and Long-Term Development Plans. - These shall cover
evaluation and packaging of development projects; investments
programming and coordination; and monitoring of program and
project implementation;
(b) Urban Renewal, Land Use Planning, and Housing and
Shelter. - These shall cover formulation, adoption and
implementation of policies, standards, programs, and projects to
rationalize and optimize urban land use, taking into consideration
urban growth and expansion. These activities shall address the

3
rehabilitation and development of identified areas and the
development of shelter and housing facilities with provisions for
necessary social services;
(c) Transport and Traffic Management. - These shall
cover formulation, coordination, and monitoring of policies,
standards, and programs that will rationalize the existing transport
operations, infrastructure requirements, use of thoroughfares,
and promotion of safe and convenient movement of persons and
goods. These activities shall include the administration
and implementation of traffic enforcement operations,
traffic engineering services, and the institution of a single
ticketing system;
(d) Solid Waste Disposal and Management. - This shall
cover formulation and implementation of policies, programs, and
projects for the proper and sanitary disposal of solid waste. It
shall likewise include the establishment and operation of a
sanitary landfill, waste to energy projects, eco-composting facility
(ECR) and related facilities, and the implementation of
other alternative programs intended to reduce, reuse, and recycle
solid waste;
(e) Flood Control and Sewerage Management. - This shall
cover formulation and implementation of policies, standards,
programs, and projects for an integrated flood control and
drainage system;
(f) Water Resource Management System. - This shall
cover formulation and implementation of policies, programs,
and projects for a comprehensive water resource system which
shall include the establishment and operation of water
source development, treatment, distribution, and sewerage
system facilities;
(g) Health, Sanitation, and Pollution Control. - This
shall cover formulation and implementation of policies, standards,
and programs to safeguard public health and maintain sanitation.
It shall ensure the promotion of ecological balance and the
prevention and control of environmental pollution;

4
(h) Public Safety and Order. - This shall cover formulation
and implementation of programs, policies, and procedures to
maintain public safety, including preparedness for preventive or
rescue operations during times of calamities and disasters,
including the implementation of contingency plans and
mobilization of resources for relief operations in coordination with
national agencies concerned; and
(1) Tourism. - This shall cover formulation and
implementation of policies, programs, and projects for the
promotion of tourism in the entire MBLISTT area.
SEc. 4. MBLISTTDA Council. - There shall be a
Metropolitan Baguio, La Trinidad, Itogon, Sablan, Tuba, and
Tublay (MBLISTT) Council, hereinafter referred to as the
Council, which shall serve as the governing board and
policy-making body of MBLISTTDA. The Council shall be
composed of the Governor of the Province of Benguet and the
Mayors of the City of Baguio and the municipalities of La Trinidad,
Itogon, Sablan, Tuba, and Tublay, as ex officio voting members.
The Council shall be composed of the following ex officio
non-voting members: (a) the Vice Mayors of Metropolitan Baguio
City and the municipalities of La Trinidad, Itogon, Sablan, Tuba,
and Tublay; (b) the duly authorized representatives of the National
Economic and Development Authority (NEDA), Department of
Transportation (DOTr), Department of Public Works and
Highways (DPWH), Department of Tourism (DOT), Department
of Information and Communications Technology (DICT),
Department of Budget and Management (DBM), Department of
Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD),
National Commission on Indigenous Peoples (NCIP), Department
of Trade and Industry (DTI), Department of Agriculture (DA),
Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR),
Department of Science and Technology (DOST), Commission on
Higher Education (CHED), Philippine National Police (PNP); and
(c) two (2) representatives from the private sector to be appointed
by the Council.

5
The Council shall be headed by a Chairman who shall
(a) be elected from among the regular members; and (b) preside
over the meetings of the Council.
In addition to the council members, there shall be an
Administrator who shall (a) be appointed by the President of the
Philippines from a list of nominees submitted by the Council;
(b) serve for a term of six (6) years; (c) continue to hold office at
the discretion of the appointing authority; (d) be vested with the
rank, rights, privileges, disqualifications, and prohibitions of an
Assistant Secretary; and (e) act as the Chief Executive Officer of
the MBLISTTDA.
The Administrator and the members of the Council, except
ex officio members, are entitled to allowances and per diems in
accordance with existing policies, rules, and regulations on the

Powers and Functions of the MBLISTTDA. - The
MBLISTTDA shall exercise the following powers and functions:
(a) Formulate, coordinate, and regulate the implementation
of medium- and long-term plans and programs for the delivery of
services, land use, and physical development within MBLISTT,
consistent with national development objectives and priorities.
The medium-term investment programs for MBLISTT-wide
services shall indicate sources and allocation of funds for priority
programs and projects;
(b) Undertake and manage its programs and projects for
the delivery of specific services under its jurisdiction, subject to
the approval of the Council. For this purpose, the MBLISTTDA
shall create appropriate project management offices;
(c) Coordinate and monitor the implementation of such
plans, programs, and projects in the City of Baguio and component
municipalities; identify bottlenecks and adopt solutions to
problems of implementation;

6
(d) Set policies concerning traffic and coordinate and
regulate the implementation of all programs and projects
concerning traffic management. It may seek assistance and
cooperation, including assignment of personnel, from other
government agencies concerned, if necessary. Install and
administer a single ticketing system, fix, impose, and collect fines
and penalties for all kinds of violations of traffic rules and
regulations. The MBLISTTDA shall enforce all traffic laws
and regulations in the MBLISTT area through its Traffic
Operation Center;
(e) Enter into contract and own properties; receive funding,
payments, grants, contributions, and donations;
(f) Sue and be sued in order to carry out its duties and
functions as provided for in this Act; and
(g) Perform other related functions required to achieve the
objectives of the MBLISTTDA, including the undertaking of
delivery of basic services to the LGUs when deemed
necessary subject to prior coordination with and consent of the
LGU concerned.
SEc. 6. Functions of the MBLISTTDA Council. - The
Council shall perform the following functions:
(a) Exercise the policy-making power of the MBLISTTDA;
(b) Approve plans, programs, and projects and issue rules
and regulations deemed necessary by the MBLISTTDA to carry
out the purposes of this Act;
(c) Fix the compensation of the officers and personnel of
the MBLISTTDA in accordance with the Salary Standardization
Law and approve the annual budget thereof for submission to
(d) Recommend investment programming for its plans and
programs, as well as supervise the implementation of plans and
programs which includes the formulation and coordination of its
related activities;

(e) Set policies and standards, and promulgate rules and
regulations governing the delivery of basic services;
(f) Endorse the annual as well as the supplemental budgets
of the MBLISTTDA; and
(g) Perform such other acts and assume such other
functions as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of

Functions of the MBLISTTDA Administrator. -
The MBLISTTDA Administrator shall:
(a) Appoint, subject to civil service laws, rules and
regulations, all subordinate officers and employees, who shall
enjoy security of tenure and may be removed only for cause in
accordance with law. The Administrator is hereby authorized to
engage the services of experts or consultants either on full-time
or part-time basis, as may be required in the performance of the
Administrator's duties and functions;
(b) Execute the policies and measures approved by the
Council and be responsible for the efficient and effective
day-to-day management of the operations of the MBLISTTDA,
and exercise the power to discipline subordinate officials and
employees under the provisions of law;
(c) Subject to the guidelines and policies set by the Council,
prepare and submit to the Council, for its approval, the
organizational structure and the staffing pattern, and fix the
number of subordinate officials and employees of the MBLISTTDA
in accordance with civil service laws, rules and regulations, and
the evaluation and approval of the DBM;
(d) Prepare the annual budget for the operations of the
MBLISTTDA for submission to the Council;
(e) Prepare an annual report on the accomplishments of
the MBLISTTDA for submission to the Council and to the
President of the Philippines; and

8
(f) Perform such other duties as may be assigned by the
President of the Philippines or by the Council.

The Senior Managers. - The Administrator shall
be assisted by a Senior Manager for Operations, a Senior Manager
for Planning, and a Senior Manager for Finance and
Administration, all of whom are appointees of the President of
the Philippines, as recommended by the Administrator and
Council, subject to civil service laws, rules and regulations.
They shall enjoy security of tenure unless removed for cause in
accordance with law.
A. The Senior Manager for Operations shall have the
following functions:
(1) Assist the Administrator in the administration of the
MBLISTTDA and supervision of subordinate personnel;
(2) Assist the Administrator in the supervision of operation
centers and units of the MBLISTTDA;
(3) Assist the Administrator in the review of plans and
programs for the MBLISTTDA and the LGUs, and in the
preparation of the annual report of the activities and
accomplishments of the MBLISTTDA; and
(4) Perform such other duties and functions as may be
lawfully delegated or assigned by the Administrator from time
B. The Senior Manager for Planning shall possess not less
than five (5) years extensive experience in development and
planning or a master's degree in Urban Planning or related
discipline, and shall have the following functions:
(1) Provide technical assistance to the Administrator;
(2) Assist in the crafting and formulation of medium- and
long-term development plan; and
(3) Perform other functions as delegated by
the Administrator.

9
C. The Senior Manager for Finance and Administration
shall perform the following functions:
(1) Assist in the preparation of the MBLISTTDA
annual budget;
(2) Assist in the preparation of medium- and long-term
investment program for the delivery of social services;
(3) Assist in the preparation of budgetary expenditure
and sources of financing programs for the operation of
MBLISTTDA; and
(4) Perform other functions as may be delegated by
the Administrator.

Institutional Linkages. - The MBLISTTDA shall,
in carrying out its functions, consult, coordinate, and work closely
with the public and private institutions, accredited people's
organizations and nongovernmental organizations operating in
the MBLISTT area.
The MBLISTTDA shall formulate a master plan to serve
as the framework for the development of the MBLISTT area. It
shall submit its development plans and investment programs to
the NEDA for integration into the Medium-Term Philippine
Development Plan (MTPDP) and Public Investment Program.
The MBLISTTDA shall, in coordination with the NEDA
and the Department of Finance (DOF), interface with foreign
assistance agencies for purposes of obtaining financial support,
grants, and donations in support of its programs and projects.

Sources of Funds and the Operating Budget of
the MBLISTTDA. -
(a) The amount necessary for the operating budget of
the MBLISTTDA shall be included in the annual General
Appropriations Act.
(b) The MBLISTTDA is empowered to levy fines and impose
fees and charges for various services rendered.

10
(c) The operations of the MBLISTTDA shall likewise be
supported through financial contributions or technical assistance
from member LGUs, nongovernment agencies (NGAs) and
government-owned and -controlled corporations (GOCCs) and the
private sector, and other local and international organizations in
the form of grants, donations, contributions, payments, penalties,
fees, and charges.
In case of grants, in-cash or in-kind, from foreign
governments or their agencies and instrumentalities, or
multilateral institutions or organizations, acceptance thereof shall
be subject to prior clearance and approval of the Council and the
President of the Philippines or the authorized representative, based
on the recommendation of the Secretary of Finance. In case of
donations, in-cash or in-kind, from foreign governments,
acceptance thereof shall require prior clearance and approval by
the Council and the President of the Philippines, or the authorized
representative based on the recommendation of the Secretary of
Foreign Affairs.

Inclusion in the MBLISTTDA. - Adjoining LGUs
that opt to be included in the MBLISTTDA shall be allowed:
Provided, That a Sanggunian Resolution for the purpose has been
passed and duly approved: Provided, further, That there shall
be a concurrence from the MBLISTTDA Council.

Implementing Rules and Regulations. - Within
ninety (90) days from the approval of this Act, the MBLISTT
Council shall promulgate the necessary rules and regulations for
the implementation of this Act.

Separability Clause. - If any part or provision of
this Act is held unconstitutional or invalid, other parts or
provisions hereof which are not affected shall continue to remain
in full force and effect.

Repealing Clause. - All laws, decrees, executive
orders, rules and regulations, or parts or provisions thereof which
are not consistent with this Act are hereby repealed, amended or
modified accordingly.

17

Effectivity. -
This Act shall take effect fifteen
(15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a
newspaper of general circulation.
